body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> EsfordesignGroup presented ''WAPER'' a 1/250 size miniature speaker of Wilson Audio''s high-end speaker ''WATT/Puppy'' during KES 2006. The company plans to release the model after getting feedback from enthusiasts.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
